render.videoTarget: Existing AndroidView GLRetroView.viewport — never core frame pixels or inferred non-black rect
zOrder: thin external bezel/glass rim clipped outside video
deck body and control seat graphics behind PadKit
decorative metal details clipped to free chassis
protected canonical brand on measured unoccupied seat
render.screenGeometrySource: P1-C2 #78: STANDARD allocated responsive 4:3, NDS flexible combined dual-screen, existing landscape preserved
render.layoutUnitRule: Asset-local normalized units, never fixed dp for gameplay or PadKit

STANDARD_4_3.placement: GameScreenLayout existing x=22dp margins, y=84dp top and 4:3 ratio; factual code baseline, not fixed artwork coordinates
STANDARD_4_3.outerBezel: inflate measured video bounds 7dp, clip outside video aperture
STANDARD_4_3.brand: protected full badge above screen if measured available space, else compact C-slot in free chassis
STANDARD_4_3.deck: solid structural panel encloses/belongs behind measured left/right PadKit group bounds; upper seam segments must subtract those bounds
STANDARD_4_3.spareSpace: continuous material body with speakers/rails and later optional faceplate mask; never blank translucent wash

DUAL_SCREEN.placement: GameScreenLayout flexible NDS x=18dp margins y=18dp top; height bounded by control groups; preserves existing combined video and DS stylus mapping
DUAL_SCREEN.outerBezel: same proportional structural thickness, extended along actual measured tall video bounds
DUAL_SCREEN.brand: compact C-slot separate from controls in lower free seat; not a button
DUAL_SCREEN.auxStrip: controls/ds-aux-strip.svg candidate, mic left / screen layout centre / menu right, independent badge on upper-right recess; relocate visual seat only after measuring actual PadKit controls
DUAL_SCREEN.upperUtility: L/R and Start/Select are functional existing PadKit elements, retain IDs/positions until Elliot checks layout

PS1_EXPANDED.analogSeat: controls/analog-seat.svg one or two if mapped

LANDSCAPE.screen: Existing overlay or no-overlay allocation unchanged
LANDSCAPE.brand: compact readable protected location chosen after game/control bounds
LANDSCAPE.seams: segment around control groups, never draw through analog/face keys

placementMath.videoExclusion: graphics masks subtract inflate(videoBounds,0dp); screen rim outside active viewport
placementMath.buttonProtection: for any seam/detail, allowed = freeChassis - union(controlBounds expanded 4dp, brandBounds expanded 8dp, GLViewport)
placementMath.deckRegion: compute from measured primary/secondary control bounds, add safe 10–16dp padding, clamp to root safe edges; draw deck behind, controls above
placementMath.controlSeat: map each visual seat to actual PadKit group bounds with scale uniformly contained, centre on control group; never change hit rectangles
placementMath.brand: try full seat where space; fallback compact C-slot, both with min 8dp decorative clearance; no lights under lettering
placementMath.glow: mask intersection with freeChassis and assigned region, default disabled
placementMath.safeInsets: respect Android displayCutout, status/navigation bars and edge gesture margins before painting

acceptance.design: 48 editable SVG masters + explicit normal/off/on/mask zones + three edition previews + standard/PS1/DS dimensioned layout maps
acceptance.runtime: no Kotlin, input, save, ROM or UI change in this design PR

maskPolicy.screen: Measured GL viewport must be subtracted from any visual frame. Source bezel masks are structural proportions only.
maskPolicy.chassis: Body/deck masks are behind functional renderer and PadKit; expose free visual regions after measured exclusion.
